name: cookie-dialog
description: Cookie Dialog for WordPress: the dialog on the site, the admin app and the blocks' editor.

scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/cookie-dialog.pot --slug=cookie-dialog --domain=cookie-dialog --exclude=node_modules,vendor,src,tests,dist,test-results,presets,bin && wp i18n update-po languages/cookie-dialog.pot languages/ && wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge --use-map='{"build/admin.js":"build/admin.min.js","build/blocks.js":"build/blocks.js"}'
